newsitem.title: USA: Wendy's says Dave Thomas in surgery Friday.
newsitem.headline: Wendy's says Dave Thomas in surgery Friday.

text.p: Wendy's International Inc's founder and spokesman Dave Thomas, 64, was having coronary bypass surgery Friday afternoon and the company did not expect to be able to issue a report on his condition immediately, a spokesman said Friday.

"He's in surgery now and probably will be until after 6 p.m.," spokesman Denny Lynch said in a telephone interview Friday afternoon, adding the company will probably issue a statement Monday on how he's doing.
Thomas founded Dublin, Ohio-based Wendy's Old Fashioned Hamburger restaurants, now a 4,800-store chain, in 1969.
He has not been involved in day-to-day operations for some time but has remained easily recognizable after years as the company's folksy television advertising spokesman.
Wendy's said earlier this week Thomas was admitted to an unnamed hospital last weekend with chest pains. He had no prior history of heart problems, the company had said.
